name: edge-spectrum
title: Edge Spectrum: returns and house edges across investing and gambling
description: 239 activities, from index funds to keno, each with an annual return (held assets) or an edge per decision (wagers), the evidence behind it, and where cited, its source, check date, window and method. Education only, not advice.

sources.title: The publishers named in each record's source field

fields.name: category
fields.description: The category it is grouped under.

fields.name: model
fields.description: "i": a held asset whose return compounds. "g": a repeated wager whose edge accrues per decision.

fields.name: layer
fields.description: "raw", or the same activity after a "fee" or "tax".

fields.name: basis
fields.description: "math": follows from the rules and payouts. "published": a rate, price, index or takeout someone publishes. "estimate": a typical outcome no one publishes as one figure.

fields.name: edge_pct
fields.description: Model "g" only: expected return per decision, percent of the stake. Negative for the player on most rows.

fields.name: decisions_per_day
fields.description: Model "g" only: decisions per day at typical play.

fields.name: capital_exposed_pct
fields.description: Model "g" only: capital exposed per decision, percent of bankroll.

fields.name: payout
fields.description: Model "g", positive-edge rows only: average net win per unit staked on a winning decision. Empty means even money.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Where the figure comes from. Empty means uncited.

fields.name: as_of
fields.description: The date the figure was last checked against its source.

resources.name: edges-spectrum
resources.description: The same records in the short-key shape the Spectrum page uses: n, cat, m, a (or e, du, ced, pay), ly, type, src, asOf, win, how, and b on math rows. Prefer edges.csv; this shape may change with the page.
